discoveryIndexNote: Community index used to locate official Riot CDN previews; not a Riot API. Actual MP4 bytes and decoded audio were checked.
reviewMethod: Matched actual weapon models and theme colors to isolated muzzle flashes, recoil and casing events. Located corresponding audio attacks using decoded waveforms, and ended every clip before the next trigger. All preview HUDs are hidden, so ammo-count evidence is unavailable.
outputProcessing: Decode complete AAC track, trim reviewed time range, reset timestamps, apply constant gain targeting stereo peak 0.7 with headroom, fade final 20ms, encode Vorbis OGG. No denoising, sound synthesis, splicing, theme substitution or time stretching.
limitations: These are authentic gunfire recordings extracted from official previews, not unpacked raw game sound files.
Late reverberation is cut before the next shot; ORA rifle clips are 0.31s and Sheriff clips 0.51s.
Operator clips include the natural bolt cycle.
Source video flashes can precede audible attacks by roughly 30–180ms. Audio cuts follow actual waveforms; frame timestamps are separate.
Separate banner animation layers remain unavailable.
